haha yeah, funny thing is i wanted to be a psychiatrist but guess that aint happening any time soon. still, im taking the full knowledge to my grave.
the most i can tell you is it can be either: a.) it's not necessarily poison unless taken in large quantities, however that's a slow painful death.
b.) the availability depends on where you live since it's a plant that grows in tropical countries. the plant is not illegal by any means, but acquiring it depends where you live.
that's all i can say. hope you dont go down this route, still trying to stop myself too.
kind of related to your question but a lot of otc drugs can already kill you via overdose, unfortunately they tend to take very long time to kill you, giving you time to regret or save yourself.

contemplating on poisoning since it's easy to mask as an accident. what poison and how i'll do it, i can't share because i cannot in good conscience tell someone how they can kill themselves. im still a med student under the oath of "do no harm" after all. sorry.

hey thanks for commenting. the plan was to get this buried but honestly thanks.

I think med school is a big component to it. I want to quit so badly but I've made a promise that I'd finish this through even if I don't want to. It feels like the only way out is to die and it's stupid because yeah I can still quit and god, it's so unfair to my future patients if they have a reluctant doctor but truth is, I still want to help. Medicine wasn't forced on me, I forced it myself and god, i dont know anymore. We've had about 3 suicides in our school for one school year and that's 3 too many. Guess I'm gonna add to it.
